READ THEM AS CLUSTERS, NOT AS TEN JOBS. Three are `founder_collision`, which
almost certainly share one root — four new peoples change who founds what, and
one of those three is explicitly "pinned per seed". Fix the cause and expect
all three to move together. `kinship_facts` and `delve_seating` are likely the
same family: person facts and settled columns both derive from who exists.
`land_list_lines_are_all_distinct_at_seed_42` is a distinctness assertion and
may be the sharpest one — with 56% name collision post-Shibboleth, "all
distinct" is the kind of claim four new peoples break for real reasons.

`plat_readout::the_section_speaks_in_the_specs_frozen_words` is the one I would
read first anyway, because "frozen words" means an authored string, and a
string test failing next to nine derivation tests is usually a different
problem wearing the same colour.
